extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current recommenders / editorial volunteers at PCI Evolutionary Biology
extracted.subtask_description: Defines the role, limits, expectations and rights of recommenders who manage the peer-evaluation of preprints for PCI Evolutionary Biology, including editorial-like tasks and compliance requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommender role — manage preprint evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: A recommender manages preprint evaluation. Their role is very similar to that of a journal editor (handling preprints, finding reviewers, collecting reviews, making editorial decisions based on reviews), with the article eventually being recommended (or not) after one or more rounds of reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit tasks listed: handling preprints, finding reviewers, collecting reviews, making editorial decisions based on reviews; decisions may require one or more rounds of review. See the PCI Evolutionary Biology Guidelines for Recommenders for more information on key roles and responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation workload limit
rubrics_metrics.description: PCI Evolutionary Biology recommenders can recommend up to five articles per year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a hard limit on the number of recommendations a recommender may make annually (no further enforcement detail provided on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommenders are expected to comply with the code of conduct of PCI Evolutionary Biology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compliance is a stated expectation; the page links to a Code of Conduct for details (not reproduced here).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Managing Board selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommenders are eligible for selection as a member of the Managing Board for a period of two years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being a recommender confers eligibility for consideration/selection to the Managing Board; the membership period mentioned is two years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to propose new recommenders
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommenders can propose the nomination of new recommenders to the Managing Board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommenders have the ability to suggest candidates for new recommender roles; ultimate nomination/approval is handled by the Managing Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the Guidelines for Recommenders
rubrics_metrics.description: Further information on key roles and responsibilities is available in the PCI Evolutionary Biology 'Guidelines for Recommenders'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page is a summary; recommenders should consult the full 'Guidelines for Recommenders' document (linked from the site) for detailed procedural rules, expectations, and best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright / licensing of published texts
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors of comments, reviews and recommendations retain copyright © under CC BY for texts published after and including 24/01/2022 and under CC-BY-ND before.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This licensing policy affects reviews, comments and recommendations that the recommender handles or publishes; recommenders should be aware of and communicate these licensing terms to authors and reviewers as appropriate.
